make.name: Infiniti
make.description: Nissan's luxury brand. It has announced electric plans several times (the LE sedan for 2014, an all-electrified line-up by 2021) but has not sold a battery-electric car.

logo.license: Trademark of Nissan Motor Co.; used to identify the brand

models.name: LE
models.description: Leaf-based electric luxury sedan shown as a 'production intent' concept at the 2012 New York Auto Show and promised for 2014. It was put on hold in 2013 and Infiniti said in 2015 it would not have such a car before 2020.

generations.name: Planned production model
generations.description: Planned 100 kW front-drive sedan with a 24 kWh-class battery and wireless charging; never built.

gaps: Infiniti is not in the legacy makes table (no legacy_id).
